### Data

Load and preprocess the collected data

```{r}
DATA_DIR <- "../data/"

wide_df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data.csv"), check.names = TRUE)
long_df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data_long.csv"), check.names = TRUE)
eod_df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data_eod.csv"), check.names = TRUE)

person_covs <- c("wave", "baseline_Age", "baseline_Gender", "baseline_Race",
                 "baseline_EdLevel", "baseline_Income", "Relationship",
                 "Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity")

controls <- paste(c(person_covs), collapse = " + ")
```

```{r}
# Collapse the sparse demographic levels that would otherwise be singleton cells.
collapse_levels <- function(x, other, other_label = "Other") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  factor(ifelse(x %in% other, other_label, x))
}

as_treatment <- function(x) {
  factor(ifelse(as.logical(x), "Deactivation", "Control"),
         levels = c("Control", "Deactivation"))
}

df <- wide_df %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = as_treatment(baseline_treatment),
    wave      = factor(wave),
    baseline_Gender = collapse_levels(baseline_Gender, c("2", "4")),
    baseline_Race   = collapse_levels(baseline_Race,   c("3", "4", "5", "6", "7")),
    Relationship = factor(
      case_when(
        baseline_Relationship == 0                ~ "Single",
        baseline_Relationship %in% c(1, 2, 3)     ~ "In Relationship",
        baseline_Relationship %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7)  ~ "Other",
        TRUE                                      ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Single", "In Relationship", "Other")
    )
  )

df$completed_endline <- ifelse(tolower(df$completed_endline) == "true", 1, 0)

sd_table <- function(stats) {
  data.frame(
    outcome       = names(stats),
    baseline_mean = vapply(stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "mean"),
    baseline_sd   = vapply(stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "sd"),
    n_baseline    = vapply(stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "n"),
    row.names     = NULL
  )
}

# Rescale `vars` in `data` using `stats`, the moments of the pre-deactivation rows.
rescale_to_baseline <- function(data, vars, stats) {
  for (v in vars) {
    s <- stats[[v]]["sd"]
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) next        # no usable baseline -> leave in raw units
    data[[v]] <- as.vector((data[[v]] - stats[[v]]["mean"]) / s)
  }
  data
}
```

```{r}
baseline_stats <- list()
df_z <- df
df_z$baseline_Usage <- df_z$Usage
dvs <- c("loneliness", "esi", "wb", "BPNSFS_Autonomy", "BPNSFS_Competence", 
         "BPNSFS_Relatedness", "problematic_use", "intensity", "Usage", 
         "lubben", "social_satisfaction", "ppl_met_inperson")
z_vars <- setdiff(dvs, c("date_since_start", "is_weekend"))

for (v in z_vars) {
  bcol <- paste0("baseline_", v)
  pcol <- paste0("endline_", v)
  if (!all(c(bcol, pcol) %in% names(df)) ||
      !is.numeric(df[[bcol]]) || !is.numeric(df[[pcol]])) next
  mu   <- mean(df[[bcol]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sdev <- sd(df[[bcol]],   na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sdev) || sdev == 0) next        # no usable baseline -> leave raw
  df_z[[bcol]] <- (df[[bcol]] - mu) / sdev
  df_z[[pcol]] <- (df[[pcol]] - mu) / sdev
  baseline_stats[[v]] <- c(mean = mu, sd = sdev, n = sum(!is.na(df[[bcol]])))
}

# reference table: what "1 SD" means for each outcome
baseline_sd_table <- data.frame(
  outcome       = names(baseline_stats),
  baseline_mean = vapply(baseline_stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "mean"),
  baseline_sd   = vapply(baseline_stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "sd"),
  n_baseline    = vapply(baseline_stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "n"),
  row.names     = NULL
)

```

### IPW ANCOVA for Baseline to Endline

```{r}
m1 <- glm(
  completed_endline ~ baseline_treatment + wave 
    + baseline_Age + baseline_Gender 
    + baseline_Race + baseline_EdLevel 
    + baseline_Income + Relationship + baseline_loneliness + baseline_esi + baseline_wb
    + Tenure + Usage + Social + Productivity + baseline_intensity 
    + baseline_problematic_use + log_approvals,
  data = df_z,
  family = binomial()
)


df_z$p1 <- predict(m1, newdata = df_z, type = "response")

df_z <- subset(
  df_z,
  completed_endline == 1
)

df_z$ipw <- 1 / (
  df_z$p1
)

summary(df_z$ipw)
```

```{r}
summary(m1)
```

```{r}
fit_primary_ipw <- function(dv, data = df_z) {
  model <- lm(
    reformulate(
      c("baseline_treatment", paste0("baseline_", dv), controls),
      response = paste0("endline_", dv)
    ),
    data = data,
    weights = ipw
  )

  # HC3 robust standard errors
  robust <- print(lmtest::coeftest(
    model,
    vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC3")
  ))

term <- grep("^baseline_treatment", rownames(robust), value = TRUE)

beta <- robust[term, "Estimate"]
se   <- robust[term, "Std. Error"]
p    <- robust[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]

# 95% CI using robust SE and residual degrees of freedom
crit <- qt(0.975, df = df.residual(model))
ci <- beta + c(-1, 1) * crit * se

cat(sprintf(
  "%s & %.3f & %.3f & [%.3f, %.3f] & %.3f \\\\\n",
  dv, beta, se, ci[1], ci[2], p
))
}
```

### Instrumental Variables Regression

```{r}

fit_late_ipw <- function(
    dv,
    data = df_z,
    exposure = "days_deactivated"
) {

  baseline <- paste0("baseline_", dv)
  endline  <- paste0("endline_", dv)

  covariates <- c(baseline, person_covs)

  # IV formula:
  # Outcome ~ exposure + covariates |
  #           assignment + covariates

  f <- as.formula(paste0(
    endline, " ~ ",
    exposure, " + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),
    " | baseline_treatment + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  model <- ivreg(
    formula = f,
    data = data,
    weights = ipw
  )

  # HC3 robust inference
  robust <- lmtest::coeftest(
    model,
    vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC3")
  )

  print(summary(model, diagnostics = TRUE))
  print(robust)

  invisible(model)
  term <- grep("^days_deactivated", rownames(robust), value = TRUE)

  beta <- robust[term, "Estimate"]
  se   <- robust[term, "Std. Error"]
  p    <- robust[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]

  # 95% CI using robust SE and residual degrees of freedom
  crit <- qt(0.975, df = df.residual(model))
  ci <- beta + c(-1, 1) * crit * se

  cat(sprintf(
    "%s & %.3f & %.3f & [%.3f, %.3f] & %.3f \\\\\n",
    dv, beta, se, ci[1], ci[2], p
  ))
}
```
